---
description: "Coding guidelines for MapStruct mappers in this e-commerce application"
applyTo:
  - "**/mapper/*Mapper.java"
---

# MapStruct Mapper Guidelines

## Purpose

MapStruct generates compile-time implementations for entity ↔ DTO conversions:
- **Type-safe** mapping at compile time
- **High performance** (no reflection)
- **Maintainable** with explicit mappings
- **Auto-generated** code in `target/generated-sources/annotations/`

## Template Structure

```java
package com.ecommerce.{feature}.mapper;

import com.ecommerce.{feature}.dto.{Feature}CreateRequest;
import com.ecommerce.{feature}.dto.{Feature}Dto;
import com.ecommerce.{feature}.dto.{Feature}UpdateRequest;
import com.ecommerce.{feature}.model.{Feature};
import org.mapstruct.*;

@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface {Feature}Mapper {

    // Entity -> DTO
    @Mapping(source = "category.id", target = "categoryId")
    @Mapping(source = "category.name", target = "categoryName")
    {Feature}Dto toDto({Feature} {feature});

    // Create Request -> Entity
    @Mapping(target = "id", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "category", ignore = true)  // Set in service
    @Mapping(target = "active", constant = "true")
    @Mapping(target = "version", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "createdDate", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "lastModifiedDate", ignore = true)
    {Feature} toEntity({Feature}CreateRequest request);

    // Update Request -> Entity (update existing entity)
    @Mapping(target = "id", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "category", ignore = true)  // Set in service if allowed
    @Mapping(target = "active", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "version", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "createdDate", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "lastModifiedDate", ignore = true)
    void updateEntityFromDto({Feature}UpdateRequest request, @MappingTarget {Feature} {feature});

    // List mapping (automatically uses toDto for each element)
    List<{Feature}Dto> toDtoList(List<{Feature}> {features});
}
```

## Required Rules

### 1. Interface Annotation
```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface {Feature}Mapper {
    // Spring will generate a @Component implementation
}
```

**Key parameters:**
- `componentModel = "spring"`: Generates Spring bean
- `unmappedTargetPolicy = ReportingPolicy.IGNORE`: Ignore unmapped fields (use sparingly)
- `uses = {OtherMapper.class}`: Use other mappers for nested objects

### 2. Common Mapping Types

**Entity to DTO:**
```java
@Mapping(source = "category.id", target = "categoryId")
@Mapping(source = "category.name", target = "categoryName")
ProductDto toDto(Product product);
```

**DTO to Entity (Create):**
```java
@Mapping(target = "id", ignore = true)           // Generated by DB
@Mapping(target = "active", constant = "true")   // Default value
@Mapping(target = "category", ignore = true)     // Set in service
Product toEntity(ProductCreateRequest request);
```

**Update Existing Entity:**
```java
@Mapping(target = "id", ignore = true)           // Don't overwrite
@Mapping(target = "createdDate", ignore = true)  // Immutable
void updateEntityFromDto(ProductUpdateRequest request, @MappingTarget Product product);
```

### 3. Mapping Annotations

**@Mapping**
```java
@Mapping(source = "fieldName", target = "targetFieldName")  // Rename field
@Mapping(target = "field", ignore = true)                    // Skip field
@Mapping(target = "field", constant = "VALUE")               // Constant value
@Mapping(target = "field", expression = "java(...)")         // Custom logic
@Mapping(target = "field", defaultValue = "default")         // Default if null
```

**@MappingTarget**
```java
// Update existing entity instead of creating new one
void updateEntity(UpdateRequest request, @MappingTarget Entity entity);
```

**@Named**
```java
// Custom mapping method
@Named("toUpperCase")
default String toUpperCase(String value) {
    return value != null ? value.toUpperCase() : null;
}

@Mapping(source = "name", target = "displayName", qualifiedByName = "toUpperCase")
ProductDto toDto(Product product);
```

**@AfterMapping**
```java
// Post-processing after mapping
@AfterMapping
default void setDefaults(@MappingTarget Product product) {
    if (product.getStock() == null) {
        product.setStock(0);
    }
}
```

**@BeforeMapping**
```java
// Pre-processing before mapping
@BeforeMapping
default void validateRequest(ProductCreateRequest request) {
    // Validation or preparation logic
}
```

## Common Patterns

### Flattening Nested Objects
```java
// Entity structure
Product {
    Long id
    String name
    Category category {
        Long id
        String name
    }
}

// Flatten to DTO
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface ProductMapper {
    
    @Mapping(source = "category.id", target = "categoryId")
    @Mapping(source = "category.name", target = "categoryName")
    ProductDto toDto(Product product);
}

// Result
ProductDto {
    Long id
    String name
    Long categoryId
    String categoryName
}
```

### Nested Mapping with Other Mappers
```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring", uses = {CategoryMapper.class})
public interface ProductMapper {
    
    // Automatically uses CategoryMapper for category field
    ProductDto toDto(Product product);
}

// ProductDto contains CategoryDto (not flattened)
public record ProductDto(
    Long id,
    String name,
    CategoryDto category  // Mapped using CategoryMapper
) {}
```

### Collection Mapping
```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface ProductMapper {
    
    ProductDto toDto(Product product);
    
    // Automatically uses toDto for each element
    List<ProductDto> toDtoList(List<Product> products);
    Set<ProductDto> toDtoSet(Set<Product> products);
}
```

### Mapping with Constants
```java
@Mapping(target = "active", constant = "true")
@Mapping(target = "status", constant = "PENDING")
Product toEntity(ProductCreateRequest request);
```

### Custom Expression
```java
@Mapping(target = "fullName", 
         expression = "java(user.getFirstName() + \" \" + user.getLastName())")
UserDto toDto(User user);

@Mapping(target = "displayPrice", 
         expression = "java(formatPrice(product.getPrice()))")
ProductDto toDto(Product product);

// Helper method in mapper
default String formatPrice(BigDecimal price) {
    return "$" + price.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
}
```

### Date/Time Formatting
```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface ProductMapper {
    
    @Mapping(source = "createdDate", target = "createdDateStr", dateFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
    ProductDto toDto(Product product);
}

// Or custom
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface ProductMapper {
    
    @Mapping(source = "createdDate", target = "createdDateStr", qualifiedByName = "formatDate")
    ProductDto toDto(Product product);
    
    @Named("formatDate")
    default String formatDate(LocalDateTime date) {
        return date != null 
            ? date.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"))
            : null;
    }
}
```

### Bi-directional Mapping
```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface ProductMapper {
    
    // Entity -> DTO
    ProductDto toDto(Product product);
    
    // DTO -> Entity (rarely used, prefer CreateRequest)
    @Mapping(target = "category", ignore = true)
    Product toEntity(ProductDto dto);
}
```

### Null Handling
```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring", nullValuePropertyMappingStrategy = NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy.IGNORE)
public interface ProductMapper {
    
    // Null values in source won't overwrite target values
    void updateEntityFromDto(ProductUpdateRequest request, @MappingTarget Product product);
}
```

### Enum Mapping
```java
// Automatic if names match
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface OrderMapper {
    OrderDto toDto(Order order);  // OrderStatus enum mapped automatically
}

// Custom if names differ
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface OrderMapper {
    
    @ValueMappings({
        @ValueMapping(source = "ACTIVE", target = "ENABLED"),
        @ValueMapping(source = "INACTIVE", target = "DISABLED")
    })
    StatusDto mapStatus(Status status);
}
```

### Conditional Mapping
```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface ProductMapper {
    
    @Mapping(target = "discount", 
             expression = "java(calculateDiscount(product))")
    ProductDto toDto(Product product);
    
    default BigDecimal calculateDiscount(Product product) {
        if (product.getPrice().compareTo(new BigDecimal("100")) > 0) {
            return product.getPrice().multiply(new BigDecimal("0.1"));
        }
        return BigDecimal.ZERO;
    }
}
```

### Ignore Fields Automatically
```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface ProductMapper {
    
    @Mapping(target = "id", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "version", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "createdDate", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "lastModifiedDate", ignore = true)
    Product toEntity(ProductCreateRequest request);
    
    // Or use @InheritInverseConfiguration to reuse mapping config
}
```

### Inherit Mapping Configuration
```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface ProductMapper {
    
    @Mapping(source = "category.id", target = "categoryId")
    @Mapping(source = "category.name", target = "categoryName")
    ProductDto toDto(Product product);
    
    @InheritInverseConfiguration
    @Mapping(target = "category", ignore = true)
    Product toEntity(ProductDto dto);
}
```

## Anti-Patterns (Avoid)

❌ **Manual mapping in service**
```java
// BAD - manual mapping
public ProductDto getProduct(Long id) {
    Product product = productRepository.findById(id).orElseThrow();
    ProductDto dto = new ProductDto();
    dto.setId(product.getId());
    dto.setName(product.getName());
    // ... tedious and error-prone
    return dto;
}
```

✅ **Use MapStruct**
```java
// GOOD - MapStruct handles it
public ProductDto getProduct(Long id) {
    Product product = productRepository.findById(id).orElseThrow();
    return productMapper.toDto(product);
}
```

❌ **Complex logic in mapper**
```java
// BAD - business logic in mapper
@Mapping(target = "finalPrice", 
         expression = "java(calculateFinalPriceWithTaxAndDiscounts(product))")
ProductDto toDto(Product product);

default BigDecimal calculateFinalPriceWithTaxAndDiscounts(Product product) {
    // 50 lines of complex calculation
}
```

✅ **Business logic in service/entity**
```java
// GOOD - simple mapping
@Mapping(source = "finalPrice", target = "finalPrice")
ProductDto toDto(Product product);

// Business logic in entity or service
public class Product {
    public BigDecimal getFinalPrice() {
        // calculation here
    }
}
```

❌ **Not ignoring audit fields**
```java
// BAD - overwrites audit fields
void updateEntityFromDto(ProductUpdateRequest request, @MappingTarget Product product);
```

✅ **Ignore audit and system fields**
```java
// GOOD - preserves audit fields
@Mapping(target = "id", ignore = true)
@Mapping(target = "createdDate", ignore = true)
@Mapping(target = "lastModifiedDate", ignore = true)
@Mapping(target = "version", ignore = true)
void updateEntityFromDto(ProductUpdateRequest request, @MappingTarget Product product);
```

## Generated Code Location

MapStruct generates implementations at compile time:
```
target/generated-sources/annotations/com/ecommerce/{feature}/mapper/{Feature}MapperImpl.java
```

To view generated code:
```bash
./mvnw compile
cat target/generated-sources/annotations/com/ecommerce/product/mapper/ProductMapperImpl.java
```

## Troubleshooting

### Mapper Not Found
**Problem**: `@Autowired` mapper is null or IDE shows error

**Solution**: Run Maven compile
```bash
./mvnw clean compile
```

### Circular Dependencies
**Problem**: Mapper has circular dependency (ProductMapper uses CategoryMapper which uses ProductMapper)

**Solution**: Use summary DTOs or flatten
```java
// Instead of full DTO
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring", uses = {CategoryMapper.class})
public interface ProductMapper {
    ProductDto toDto(Product product);  // Contains CategoryDto (circular)
}

// Use summary or flatten
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface ProductMapper {
    @Mapping(source = "category.id", target = "categoryId")
    @Mapping(source = "category.name", target = "categoryName")
    ProductDto toDto(Product product);  // Flattened (no circular)
}
```

### Unmapped Properties Warning
**Problem**: Build warnings about unmapped properties

**Solution**: Explicitly ignore or map all fields
```java
@Mapping(target = "unusedField", ignore = true)
ProductDto toDto(Product product);

// Or suppress globally (not recommended)
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring", unmappedTargetPolicy = ReportingPolicy.IGNORE)
```

## Testing

Mappers are tested via integration tests or directly:

```java
@SpringBootTest
class ProductMapperTest {

    @Autowired
    private ProductMapper productMapper;

    @Test
    void shouldMapEntityToDto() {
        // Given
        Category category = new Category();
        category.setId(1L);
        category.setName("Electronics");

        Product product = new Product();
        product.setId(10L);
        product.setName("Laptop");
        product.setPrice(new BigDecimal("999.99"));
        product.setCategory(category);

        // When
        ProductDto dto = productMapper.toDto(product);

        // Then
        assertThat(dto.id()).isEqualTo(10L);
        assertThat(dto.name()).isEqualTo("Laptop");
        assertThat(dto.price()).isEqualTo(new BigDecimal("999.99"));
        assertThat(dto.categoryId()).isEqualTo(1L);
        assertThat(dto.categoryName()).isEqualTo("Electronics");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldMapCreateRequestToEntity() {
        // Given
        ProductCreateRequest request = new ProductCreateRequest(
            "Mouse",
            new BigDecimal("29.99"),
            100,
            2L
        );

        // When
        Product product = productMapper.toEntity(request);

        // Then
        assertThat(product.getId()).isNull();  // Not set
        assertThat(product.getName()).isEqualTo("Mouse");
        assertThat(product.getPrice()).isEqualTo(new BigDecimal("29.99"));
        assertThat(product.getActive()).isTrue();  // Default
    }
}
```

## Checklist

When creating a mapper:
- [ ] Interface with @Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
- [ ] Entity -> DTO mapping
- [ ] CreateRequest -> Entity mapping
- [ ] UpdateRequest -> Entity update mapping (with @MappingTarget)
- [ ] Ignore id, version, audit fields in create/update
- [ ] Set default values (active = true) in create mapping
- [ ] Flatten nested objects or use other mappers
- [ ] Handle null values appropriately
- [ ] List/collection mappings if needed
- [ ] Custom mapping methods for complex transformations
- [ ] Test mapper functionality
